resources.string: We will show you what each part of the app is for. Use Next to move forward and Back to go back. You can leave at any time.
Tap here to switch the app between Spanish and English.
Switch the look of the app between light and dark mode.
Use this button to open this tour again whenever you want.
Signs you out of your account. It asks for confirmation first.
Switch between sections: Home, Advisories, Payments and Profile.
To enter and leave the gym, look at the reception camera. Here you can see how many people are inside right now.
Chart of attendance by hour. Tap a bar to see its exact value.
Pick a day of the week: below you will see the average entries per time slot and the best times to come.
Each card shows an instructor, their available spots and their monthly cost.
Tap Request to ask for it. It stays Pending (you can cancel it) until it is Approved. If it says No spots, that instructor is full.
Tap the plan you want to pay for. Then you will see the payment methods (transfer, deposit or cash) and you can upload a photo of your receipt.
After you send your receipt, this part of the screen shows whether it is under review, validated or rejected (with the reason).
This is the photo taken at reception when your face was registered. It cannot be changed from here.
Here you can see whether your membership is Active or Inactive. Above is your membership number and below your plan and its expiry date.
Update your phone number. Name and email cannot be changed.
Register who should be notified in case of an emergency.
Enter your current password and the new one. It must have at least 8 characters, with upper case, lower case, a number and a symbol.
Your registered name, phone and email. Your emergency contact is shown further below.
We will show you how to check your assigned clients and use your profile. Use Next to move forward and Back to go back.
Tap here to switch the app between Spanish and English.
Switch the look of the app between light and dark mode.
Use this button to open this tour again whenever you want.
Signs you out of your account. It asks for confirmation first.
Switch between My clients and Profile.
Each card is a client assigned to you. You can see their name, training days and goal.
Tap Edit to set the days this client will attend and their goal.
Your profile photo is taken by the manager; it cannot be changed from here.
Shows whether your account is Active or Inactive.
Update your phone number. Name and email are not edited here.
Your registered name, phone and email.
This is the maximum number of clients you can take. Next to it you will see whether you still have free spots or you are full.
We will show you the tools to assist clients: face access, registration, visits, requests and payments. Use Next to move forward and Back to go back.
Tap here to open the menu with all the sections.
Home (face access), Clients, Visits, Requests, Payments and Profile. Tap one to go to it.
Switch the app between Spanish and English.
Switch the look of the app between light and dark mode.
Signs you out of your account. It asks for confirmation first.
Use this button to open this tour again whenever you want.
Shows how many people are inside the gym right now.
The client stands inside the frame and looks at the camera. The system recognizes them and records their entry or exit. Below you can see the instruction and the progress.

When someone is recognized you will see their photo, name, membership and status, and since when they are inside. Notices are also shown, for example when the membership is inactive or the face is not recognized.
Type a name or a membership number to filter the list.
Opens the registration form: client details, plan, emergency contact, payment method and health data. After saving you will be asked to register their face for access.
Tap the photo. A green border means the face is already registered: it opens larger and you can update it from there. Otherwise the face registration opens.
Shows whether the client is Active or Inactive. On the left you can see the expiry date and whether they are inside or outside the gym.
Change the client\'s details. It is always available.
If the membership has expired, Renew appears: you choose the plan and the payment is recorded. If it is active, Cancel appears: it sends a cancellation request that the manager authorizes.
Here you charge the entry of a person who is not a client. At the top you see the visit price; if it is not set or not enabled for Reception, a red notice appears.
Enter the visitor\'s name and phone, their emergency contact and the payment method.
The button is enabled once the form is complete. It asks you to confirm before registering the visit.
Below you will see the visits registered today, with phone, time, amount and payment method.
Requests that clients make to an instructor arrive here. At the top you see how many are pending.
Shows the client, their membership, the instructor, the date, the cost and the status.
On pending requests, the check mark approves and the X rejects. It asks for confirmation first.
The payment receipts that clients send and that are waiting for your review appear here.
This is the image the client uploaded. Tap it to see it larger.
Accept validates the payment and updates the membership validity. Reject asks for a reason, which the client will be able to see.
Enter your current password and the new one. It must have at least 8 characters, with upper case, lower case, a number and a symbol.
Your name, phone, email and registration date.
We will show you how to check the state of the gym and manage clients, staff, services, payments, expenses and reports. Use Next to move forward and Back to go back.
Tap here to open the menu with all the sections.
Dashboard, Clients, Staff, Services, Payments, Visits, Expenses and Reports. Tap one to go to it.
Switch the app between Spanish and English.
Switch the look of the app between light and dark mode.
Signs you out of your account. It asks for confirmation first.
Use this button to open this tour again whenever you want.
How many people are in the gym right now. It updates by itself.
Clients whose membership is not valid.
Total income accumulated during the month.
Today\'s entries for each hour, from 6:00 to 21:00. Below you will see the peak hour.
Compares active and inactive clients month by month.
Income for each day of the week.
Type a name or a membership number to filter the list.
Opens the registration form: client details, plan, emergency contact, payment method and health data. After saving you will be asked to register their face for access.
Tap the photo. A green border means the face is already registered: it opens larger and you can update it from there. Otherwise the face registration opens.
Shows whether the client is Active or Inactive. On the left you can see the expiry date and whether they are inside or outside the gym.
Change the client\'s details. It is always available.
If the membership has expired, Renew appears: you choose the plan and the payment is recorded. If it is active, Cancel appears: it starts the cancellation and you authorize or reject it in Reports.

Register someone as Reception, Instructor or Manager: name, phone, email and role (for instructors also their cost and client capacity), plus their health data. Afterwards their profile photo is taken.
Tap the photo. If there is one, it opens larger and you can update it; if not, the camera opens to take it.
Name, role, email and status (Active or Inactive).
The pencil edits the user\'s details and the X deletes them. It asks for confirmation before deleting.
Set the name, duration in days and cost. You can mark it as the Visit service and choose whether clients and/or Reception can see it.
Each card shows the name, duration, price and who can see it.
The pencil edits the service and the X deletes it (with confirmation).
The clients\' payment receipts that are pending review appear here.
This is the image the client uploaded. Tap it to see it larger.
Accept validates the payment and updates the membership validity. Reject asks for a reason, which the client will be able to see.
Charge the entry of a person who is not a client. At the top you see the visit price, which is set in Services (the service marked as Visit).
Enter the visitor\'s name and phone, their emergency contact and the payment method.
The button is enabled once the form is complete. It asks you to confirm before registering the visit.
Below you will see the visits registered today, with phone, time, amount and payment method.
Record an expense with its concept, category, amount and date.
Each card shows the concept, category, amount and date.
The pencil edits the expense and the X deletes it (with confirmation).
When Reception asks to cancel a membership, the request appears here at the top. You can Authorize or Reject it (rejecting needs a reason).
For each month: income from services and advisories, expenses and the total (services + advisories - expenses).
History of cancelled memberships. If a refund is pending, use Mark as delivered once you have handed it to the client.
Create a new broadcast notice for clients or staff with its type, title, message, and effective date.
Each card shows the title, message, effective date, and email sending progress.
If there are pending recipients left to receive the notice email, use this button to send them.
You can skip it and open it again whenever you want with the ? button in the top bar.
A guided tour of your account: home, advisories, payments and profile.
A guided tour of Reception: face access, clients, visits, requests, payments and profile.
A guided tour of your assigned clients and your profile.
A guided tour of the dashboard, clients, staff, services, payments, visits, expenses, reports and notices.
You now know the features of your view. You can repeat this tour whenever you want with the ? button in the top bar.
